component.title: DirtyStateGuard
component.purpose: Protect meaningful unsaved work while keeping save, discard, and continue-editing recovery explicit.

states.description: An editable draft with no prompt until a leave request is made.
A blocking recovery prompt with save, discard, and continue editing actions.

responsive.mobile: The recovery actions become full-width controls in priority order.

keyboard: All recovery actions are keyboard operable
semantics: alertdialog has a labelled title and persistent description
beforeunload is only registered while meaningful work is dirty

reducedMotion: The prompt remains fully usable with its entrance animation disabled.
